Su hilo conductor es el «espacio sin nombre»: el instante en que todavía es posible observar antes de convertir una sensación en una identidad, un juicio o una reacción automática.
antes-de-que-tu-mente-le-ponga-nombre.target_audience: Para lectores que buscan una práctica de mindfulness realista para momentos en los que la calma no aparece por voluntad.

cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza.summary: Cuando el dinero no alcanza propone un método de decisión para cuando los ingresos ya no cubren el coste real de una vida razonable. Distingue entre ahorrar, sustituir y cambiar el modelo de vida; ordena los gastos por la función que cumplen; protege salud, seguridad, capacidad de trabajar, futuro y dignidad; y aplica esa lógica a comida, vivienda, transporte, medicación, educación, familia, deuda, ahorros y recuperación financiera. cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza.target_audience: Para lectores generales que atraviesan presión económica y necesitan reorganizar gastos esenciales y cotidianos sin sacrificar innecesariamente salud, seguridad, relaciones, futuro o dignidad.

deja-de-explicarte.summary: Deja de explicarte examina la diferencia entre una explicación necesaria y la defensa compulsiva de la propia existencia. El libro sigue la necesidad de ser comprendido a través de la familia, el amor, el trabajo, el dinero, las redes sociales, los límites y el hábito de convertir cada decisión en un expediente. No propone dejar de asumir responsabilidades; propone reconocer cuándo explicar aclara y cuándo solo prolonga un juicio que no terminará con más palabras.
deja-de-explicarte.target_audience: Para personas cansadas de justificarse, demostrar su valor y vivir pendientes de la opinión ajena.
deja-de-explicarte.title: Deja de explicarte

kendini-ac-klamay-b-rak.summary: Kendini Açıklamayı Bırak, gerekli açıklama, sorumluluk ve onarım ile insanın varlığını sürekli savunma dosyasına çevirmesi arasındaki farkı inceler. Amaç daha az konuşmak değil; her yanlış anlaşılmada kendini mahkemeye çıkarmaktan vazgeçmektir.
kendini-ac-klamay-b-rak.target_audience: Sürekli yanlış anlaşılmaktan, kendini kanıtlamaktan ve başkalarının yargılarına cevap yetiştirmekten yorulan okurlar için.
kendini-ac-klamay-b-rak.title: Kendini Açıklamayı Bırak

learning: Distinguish a foundation model from its harness, agent layer, product surface, and infrastructure.
Evaluate long-context claims separately from memory, retrieval, and compaction strategies.
Understand open-weight deployment, serving constraints, and swarm economics.
Compare agent products through controlled tasks, latency, cost, and human-attention requirements.
Read vendor specifications and benchmark claims with explicit dates, evidence, and limitations.
kimi-k3-and-the-agentic-frontier.seo_description: A practical technical guide to Kimi K3, open weights, long context, agent swarms, serving, benchmarks, and comparisons with Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.
kimi-k3-and-the-agentic-frontier.subtitle: Open Weights, Million-Token Context, Agent Swarms, and a Practical Comparison with Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex
kimi-k3-and-the-agentic-frontier.summary: Kimi K3 and the Agentic Frontier examines modern agentic AI by separating the model, harness, agent, product, and infrastructure layers that are often conflated. The book studies long context versus memory and compaction, sparse mixture-of-experts design, native vision, open weights, serving and self-hosting, agent swarms, sandboxed execution, economics, failure modes, benchmarks, and product-level comparisons with Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. Time-sensitive specifications and vendor claims are treated as dated evidence rather than timeless facts.
kimi-k3-and-the-agentic-frontier.target_audience: For AI engineers, researchers, developers, and technical decision-makers comparing agentic systems and deployment models.
kimi-k3-and-the-agentic-frontier.title: Kimi K3 and the Agentic Frontier

Disiplin burada kendine şiddet değil, kötü günde bile ilişkiyi tamamen koparmamaktır.

learning: Separate karma from threats, magical thinking, and passive avoidance.
Recognize the attention and energy cost of revenge and constant proof-seeking.
Use boundaries and distance without turning them into punishment theatre.
Distinguish forgiveness from renewed access or denial of harm.
Build a life organized around conduct, peace, joy, and forward movement.
let-karma-handle-it.seo_description: A reflective practical guide to karma, revenge, betrayal, boundaries, forgiveness, peace, prosperity, and reclaiming energy from the need to punish.
let-karma-handle-it.subtitle: A Cosmic Law of Return for Peace, Joy, Prosperity, and Life Beyond Revenge
let-karma-handle-it.summary: Let Karma Handle It reframes karma as a language of return and balance rather than a threat, superstition, or excuse for passivity. Its practical concern is what happens when a person stops spending attention on revenge, proving, surveillance, and the wish to administer consequences personally. Across themes of betrayal, anger, boundaries, silence, forgiveness, prosperity, joy, and a thirty-day practice map, the book asks the reader to protect conduct and energy without becoming an assistant to punishment.
let-karma-handle-it.target_audience: For readers trying to move beyond betrayal, resentment, or revenge without surrendering boundaries or self-respect.
let-karma-handle-it.title: Let Karma Handle It

learning: Build intuition for simple and multiple linear regression before relying on formulas.
Understand coefficients, residuals, least squares, and common error measures.
Prepare data and diagnose assumptions, outliers, multicollinearity, and overfitting.
Use regularization and model-improvement methods appropriately.
Implement, interpret, communicate, and apply regression models in Python and real projects.
linear-regression-in-machine-learning-an.seo_description: A visual guide to linear regression covering intuition, least squares, diagnostics, regularization, Python, real-world case studies, and model interpretation.
linear-regression-in-machine-learning-an.subtitle: From Fundamentals to Real-World Applications
linear-regression-in-machine-learning-an.summary: Linear Regression in Machine Learning and Data Science is a visual path from intuition to implementation. It introduces simple and multiple linear regression, the best-fit line, coefficients, residuals, error measures, and least-squares reasoning before moving into data preparation, assumptions, diagnostics, regularization, multicollinearity, Python implementation, case studies, interpretation, and communication. Its recurring learning flow combines definitions, formulas, warnings, examples, code, outputs, and takeaways so that mathematical ideas remain connected to actual modeling decisions.
linear-regression-in-machine-learning-an.target_audience: For students, analysts, data scientists, machine-learning learners, and practitioners who want regression explained visually and implemented practically.
linear-regression-in-machine-learning-an.title: Linear Regression in Machine Learning and Data Science

learning: Draw support and resistance as reaction zones rather than demanding exact-price precision.
Read rejection wicks, closes, repeated acceptance, and role reversal after breakouts.
Differentiate bounce, breakout-retest, and fake-breakout scenarios.
Use round numbers and liquidity references as context rather than automatic signals.
Define confirmation, invalidation, position size, and risk before committing capital.
mastering-support-and-resistance.seo_description: A visual support and resistance guide covering zones, breakouts, retests, fakeouts, wick-versus-body confirmation, round numbers, entries, exits, and risk.
mastering-support-and-resistance.subtitle: 80 Practical Visual Infographics for Reading Levels, Entries, Exits, Breakouts, Retests, and Traps
mastering-support-and-resistance.summary: Mastering Support & Resistance is a visual guide to reading support and resistance as behavioral zones rather than perfect single-price lines. It develops demand and supply zones, liquidity references, role reversal after a breakout, bounce setups, breakout-and-retest structures, fake-breakout traps, wick-versus-body interpretation, repeated closes, round-number reactions, invalidation, position sizing, and journaling. The visual framework emphasizes confirmation and risk control instead of assuming that any marked level must hold.
mastering-support-and-resistance.target_audience: For visual price-action traders who want a practical framework for levels, reactions, breakouts, retests, and traps.
mastering-support-and-resistance.title: Mastering Support & Resistance

learning: Distinguish privacy from secrecy and friendship from emotional displacement.
Assess small behaviors through repetition, concealment, intention, and impact rather than labels alone.
Talk about digital boundaries before mistrust becomes surveillance.
Recognize the difference between a repairable mistake and a recurring pattern.
Protect self-respect while deciding whether trust can be rebuilt or a relationship should end.
micro-cheating.seo_description: A relationship guide to micro-cheating, secrecy, digital intimacy, emotional boundaries, trust erosion, repair, and mature fidelity.
micro-cheating.subtitle: The Quiet Betrayals of Modern Love
micro-cheating.summary: Micro Cheating examines small, repeated behaviors that can erode trust before a relationship reaches the territory of a conventional affair. It distinguishes privacy from secrecy, friendship from emotional outsourcing, ordinary human error from recurring concealment, and forgiveness from self-abandonment. Across phones, messages, likes, former partners, workplace closeness, emotional backup relationships, boundaries, confession, repair, staying, leaving, and mature fidelity, the book seeks clarity rather than surveillance.
micro-cheating.target_audience: For readers navigating trust, boundaries, digital behavior, and emotional fidelity in modern relationships.
micro-cheating.title: Micro Cheating

learning: Distinguir privacidad de secreto y amistad de desplazamiento emocional.
Evaluar conductas pequeñas por repetición, ocultación, intención e impacto.
Hablar de límites digitales antes de convertir la relación en vigilancia.
Diferenciar un error reparable de un patrón que sigue erosionando la confianza.
Proteger la dignidad personal al decidir si la confianza puede reconstruirse.
microinfidelidad.seo_description: Guía sobre microinfidelidad, secretos, intimidad digital, límites emocionales, exparejas, confianza, reparación y fidelidad madura.
microinfidelidad.subtitle: Pequeñas traiciones que erosionan la confianza en las relaciones modernas
microinfidelidad.summary: Microinfidelidad examina conductas pequeñas y repetidas que pueden erosionar la confianza antes de convertirse en una infidelidad convencional. La edición en español de España distingue intimidad de secreto, amistad de desplazamiento emocional, error puntual de patrón oculto y perdón de autoabandono. Mensajes, redes sociales, exparejas, cercanía laboral, personas de reserva, límites digitales, confesión, reparación, quedarse, marcharse y fidelidad madura se estudian con una pregunta constante: qué está ocurriendo realmente y qué necesita la relación para seguir siendo honesta.
microinfidelidad.target_audience: Para lectores que quieren comprender mejor la confianza, los límites y la fidelidad emocional en las relaciones modernas.
microinfidelidad.title: Microinfidelidad

mikro-aldatma.summary: Mikro Aldatma, modern ilişkilerde güveni büyük bir olaydan önce aşındırabilen küçük ama tekrarlanan davranışları inceler. Kitap; mahremiyet ile gizlilik, arkadaşlık ile duygusal yön değiştirme, bir insanî hata ile güveni kemiren örüntü arasındaki farkı araştırır. Telefon, mesajlar, beğeniler, eski partnerler, iş ilişkileri, sınırlar, itiraf, onarım, duygusal ilişki, kalmak ya da ayrılmak gibi alanları ele alırken amacı gözetim değil, daha açık bir dil ve daha dürüst sınırlar kurmaktır.
mikro-aldatma.target_audience: Modern ilişkilerde güven, sınır, dijital davranış ve duygusal sadakat üzerine daha net düşünmek isteyen okurlar için.

Gelir artınca eski tüm giderleri otomatik olarak geri getirmemek.

para-yetmediginde.summary: Para Yetmediğinde, gelirin artık makul bir hayatın gerçek maliyetini karşılamadığı dönemler için karar verme yöntemi sunar. Amaç en ucuz hayatı değil, önemli olanı mümkün olduğunca koruyan en düşük maliyetli sürdürülebilir hayatı kurmaktır.
para-yetmediginde.target_audience: Ekonomik baskı altında gıda, barınma, ulaşım, sağlık, eğitim, borç ve günlük tüketim kararlarını yeniden düzenlemek isteyen genel okur için.

İnsanların, alışkanlıkların ve dikkat tüketiminin değeri nasıl düşürdüğünü görmek.

sen-daha-az-icin-fazla-degerlisin.summary: Sen Daha Azı İçin Fazla Değerlisin, özdeğeri üstünlük iddiası olarak değil, hayatın hangi alanlarında kendini sessizce ucuzlattığını görme yeteneği olarak ele alır. Yapay zekâ ise peygamber ya da otorite değil, düşünmeyi hızlandıran ve israfı azaltabilen bir kaldıraç olarak çerçevelenir.

İnsanların, alışkanlıkların ve dijital gürültünün gizli maliyetini fark etmek.
Aile, aşk, arkadaşlık ve işte daha temiz sınırlar kurmak.

Çıkarılan şeylerin ardından daha sakin ve tutarlı bir hayat inşa etmek.

silmenin-gucu.summary: Silmenin Gücü, hayatı sadeleştirmeyi sertlik ya da intikam olarak değil, huzuru tekrar tekrar bozan erişimleri, alışkanlıkları ve içsel döngüleri bilinçli biçimde azaltmak olarak ele alır. Kitap dikkat, ilişkiler, aile, arkadaşlık, aşk, iş ve statü, sosyal medya, suçluluk, standartlar, bedensel sinyaller ve temiz sınırlar üzerinden hem dışarıdaki hem içerideki fazlalığı inceler. Amaç, insanları cezalandırmak değil, kurulmakta olan hayatı sürekli yaralayan şeylere sınırsız erişim vermemektir.
silmenin-gucu.target_audience: Huzurunu korumak, sınırlarını netleştirmek ve hayatındaki gereksiz zihinsel yükü azaltmak isteyen okurlar için.
silmenin-gucu.title: Silmenin Gücü

learning: Build a reliable relational foundation with tables, keys, schemas, and relationships.
Write clean queries using filtering, sorting, joins, grouping, aggregation, CTEs, and windows.
Handle data types, imports, constraints, integrity, DDL, DML, and transactions safely.
Interpret query results as business evidence rather than stopping at syntax.
Practice interview patterns, real projects, optimization, and portfolio delivery across SQL dialects.
sql-for-data-analysis.seo_description: A visual SQL guide from relational foundations and joins to CTEs, window functions, interview problems, business projects, optimization, dashboards, and portfolio work.
sql-for-data-analysis.subtitle: A Visual, Practical Guide with Real Business Projects, Interview Problems, CTEs, Window Functions, Dashboards, and Portfolio Workflows
sql-for-data-analysis.summary: SQL for Data Analysis is a visual, practice-oriented path from relational foundations to portfolio-ready analytics. It covers database structure, schema design, SELECT queries, filtering, sorting, joins, aggregation, data types, import and export, constraints and integrity, DDL and DML, transactions, CTEs, subqueries, views, temporary logic, window functions, ranking, interview problems, projects, optimization, and business interpretation. The book is dialect-aware and repeatedly emphasizes safe execution: destructive statements are tested in controlled environments, rows are verified, transactions are used, and SELECT comes before change.
sql-for-data-analysis.target_audience: For aspiring data analysts, data scientists, business analysts, and developers who want practical SQL skills tied to real analytical work.
sql-for-data-analysis.title: SQL for Data Analysis

learning: Distinguish useful explanation from compulsive self-justification.
Recognize when the hunger to be understood becomes self-erasure.
Stop feeding arguments with people who are unwilling to listen in good faith.
Use cleaner boundaries in family, love, work, and online spaces.
Choose silence deliberately when more explanation would not create clarity.
stop-explaining-yourself.seo_description: A practical guide to over-explaining, approval seeking, boundaries, clean refusals, social judgment, and leaving the courtroom of other people's opinions.
stop-explaining-yourself.subtitle: How to Leave the Courtroom of Other People's Opinions
stop-explaining-yourself.summary: Stop Explaining Yourself examines the difference between responsible explanation and compulsive self-defense. It follows the urge to be understood through family roles, relationships, work, money, social media, boundaries, and the endless internal courtroom where every choice seems to require a case. The book does not argue for silence or avoidance of accountability; it asks when explanation stops clarifying and starts erasing the person who is explaining.
stop-explaining-yourself.target_audience: For readers exhausted by proving, defending, and translating themselves to people whose judgment has become an internal courtroom.
stop-explaining-yourself.title: Stop Explaining Yourself

learning: Separate context and execution by assigning distinct jobs to 5-minute and 1-minute charts.
Use defined setup rules instead of reacting to every fast candle.
Account for spread, slippage, fees, stops, sizing, and daily loss limits.
Recognize abnormal, news-driven, and overtrading conditions where no trade is justified.
Test and journal setups through replay, simulation, metrics, and a 30-session practice program.
the-1-minute-and-5-minute-scalping-playb.seo_description: A practical 1-minute and 5-minute scalping guide to market structure, precision entries, eight setup playbooks, costs, risk, journaling, and testing.
the-1-minute-and-5-minute-scalping-playb.subtitle: A Practical Guide to Market Structure, Precision Entries, Fast Trade Management, and Risk Control
the-1-minute-and-5-minute-scalping-playb.summary: The 1-Minute & 5-Minute Scalping Playbook assigns different jobs to the two timeframes: the 5-minute chart provides context, structure, and location, while the 1-minute chart is used as an execution lens. It develops precision entries, transaction-cost awareness, stops, position sizing, targets, fast trade management, no-trade conditions, journaling, replay, and backtesting. Eight setup playbooks cover trend pullbacks, liquidity sweeps and reclaims, breakouts and retests, failed breakouts, opening-range momentum, VWAP reactions, compression-to-expansion, and 5-minute reversal with 1-minute confirmation.
the-1-minute-and-5-minute-scalping-playb.target_audience: For active short-term traders who want a rules-based scalping process rather than improvised one-minute entries.
the-1-minute-and-5-minute-scalping-playb.title: The 1-Minute & 5-Minute Scalping Playbook

learning: Recognize how waiting for an explanation can keep a life psychologically suspended.
Stop treating silence as a puzzle that must be solved indefinitely.
Understand acceptance without confusing it with approval of what happened.
Build closure through your own actions when no final answer is available.
Use small practices to rebuild movement, trust, and attention after an unanswered ending.
the-day-you-stop-needing-a-reason.seo_description: A practical guide to unanswered endings, acceptance, closure, silence, distance, self-worth, rebuilding, and moving forward without receiving an explanation.
the-day-you-stop-needing-a-reason.subtitle: A Practical Guide to Acceptance, Calm, and Moving Through Unanswered Endings
the-day-you-stop-needing-a-reason.summary: The Day You Stop Needing a Reason examines what happens when life remains suspended beside an explanation that never arrives. Through unanswered endings, the courtroom of memory, the body waiting for a message, the empty chair, not being chosen, silence, distance, acceptance without approval, self-made closure, rebuilding, and trust after ambiguity, the book offers a way to move without pretending that unanswered questions do not hurt. Thirty practices turn the idea of closure into small acts rather than a final speech from someone else.
the-day-you-stop-needing-a-reason.target_audience: For readers moving through a breakup, loss, rejection, or unfinished story that did not provide a satisfying explanation.
the-day-you-stop-needing-a-reason.title: The Day You Stop Needing a Reason

learning: Distinguish a hard day from an emergency, exhaustion, or simple resistance.
Scale work down without abandoning it completely when capacity is reduced.
Use minimum actions, return rituals, logs, and environment design to lower friction.
Rest without converting recovery into indefinite avoidance.
Build consistency around returning to the work rather than waiting for the right feeling.
the-discipline-of-bad-days.seo_description: A practical guide to discipline on bad days: minimum actions, return rituals, energy, boundaries, rest, resistance, shame, and finishing work without waiting for motivation.
the-discipline-of-bad-days.subtitle: Finish the Work Without Waiting to Feel Better
the-discipline-of-bad-days.summary: The Discipline of Bad Days is about continuing meaningful work without pretending that every difficult day is ordinary. It distinguishes emergencies and genuine exhaustion from resistance, then replaces the demand for perfect motivation with smaller, humane minimum actions, return rituals, clean boundaries, rest that does not become desertion, and systems that reduce dependence on mood. Across forty-two chapters and a field manual, the book treats consistency as the ability to return rather than the ability to perform at maximum intensity every day.
the-discipline-of-bad-days.target_audience: For writers, creators, professionals, students, and anyone who wants a humane system for continuing through low-motivation or difficult days.
the-discipline-of-bad-days.title: The Discipline of Bad Days

learning: Separate measured IQ from human value and from the full range of cognitive ability.
Recognize how high cognitive intensity may interact with solitude, understimulation, and overthinking.
Understand emotional intensity, sensory sensitivity, and the cost of social masking.
Develop healthier approaches to perfectionism, work, authority, and relationships.
Read research on gifted populations with attention to sample limitations and uncertainty.
the-high-resolution-mind.seo_description: A cautious guide to the psychology of extremely high-IQ minds, covering overthinking, solitude, sensitivity, masking, perfectionism, work, relationships, and cognitive design.
the-high-resolution-mind.subtitle: The Hidden Psychology of Extremely High-IQ Minds
the-high-resolution-mind.summary: The High-Resolution Mind examines very high cognitive ability without turning IQ into a measure of human worth or a mythology of genius. It explores the limits of IQ scores, cognitive speed and depth, asynchronous development, solitude, overthinking, emotional intensity, sensory sensitivity, social masking, understimulation, perfectionism, intellectual humility, memory, love, work, authority, twice-exceptionality, darker failure modes, and the ethics of designing a life around unusual cognitive needs. Research claims are framed with attention to sampling and generalization limits.
the-high-resolution-mind.target_audience: For readers interested in giftedness, very high cognitive ability, and the psychological and social patterns that may accompany it.
the-high-resolution-mind.title: The High-Resolution Mind

learning: Interpret moving averages as state estimates with explicit memory rather than prediction lines.
Compare filter length and weighting schemes through the trade-off between responsiveness and noise.
Understand convolution as the mathematical engine behind weighted moving averages.
Distinguish causal, live-usable averages from centered or future-dependent calculations.
Audit indicators for data provenance, real-time calculability, repainting, and informational delay.
the-mathematical-anatomy-of-moving-avera.seo_description: A quantitative visual guide to moving averages as filters, covering SMA, EMA, WMA, HMA, adaptive methods, lag, noise, convolution, causality, and look-ahead bias.
the-mathematical-anatomy-of-moving-avera.subtitle: Advanced Trading, Deep Quantitative Insight, and Professional Applications
the-mathematical-anatomy-of-moving-avera.summary: The Mathematical Anatomy of Moving Averages treats moving averages as filters that estimate a slower market state rather than as predictive lines. Its visual explanations connect observed price, latent trend, noise, memory length, weighting schemes, responsiveness, smoothness, and lag. SMA, EMA, WMA, HMA, and adaptive ideas are compared through the signal-noise trade-off, convolution and weighting kernels, while causal versus centered averages expose look-ahead bias, repainting, and the difference between a beautiful historical line and a calculation that was actually available in real time.
the-mathematical-anatomy-of-moving-avera.target_audience: For technically minded traders, quantitative learners, and strategy developers who want to understand what moving averages actually compute.
the-mathematical-anatomy-of-moving-avera.title: The Mathematical Anatomy of Moving Averages:

learning: Separate observable danger from stories amplified by fear and projection.
Use discernment without reducing a whole person to a single frightening label.
Recognize borrowed fears, gossip, and unresolved pain in judgment.
Examine one's own shadow before assigning all darkness to others.
Hold boundaries and clarity while restoring a more human view of reality.
the-monster-in-the-mirror.seo_description: A reflective guide to fear, judgment, projection, demonization, boundaries, gossip, self-awareness, and restoring clearer perception.
the-monster-in-the-mirror.subtitle: How Fear Turns Other People Into Shadows, and How Awareness Restores the Face of Truth
the-monster-in-the-mirror.summary: The Monster in the Mirror explores how fear, pain, rumor, and judgment can flatten another person into a frightening symbol. It does not ask readers to deny danger or abandon boundaries; it asks them to separate fact from fear, discernment from demonization, and protection from projection. Fourteen chapters and a twenty-one-day mirror practice examine borrowed monsters, gossip, hidden wounds, the pause before judgment, one’s own shadow, and the possibility of restoring a human face without surrendering clarity.
the-monster-in-the-mirror.target_audience: For readers interested in self-awareness, fear, judgment, and the ethics of seeing other people more accurately.
the-monster-in-the-mirror.title: The Monster in the Mirror

learning: Treat deletion as a decision about access and attention rather than revenge.
Identify the hidden tax of repeated disturbance in relationships, habits, and digital life.
Use cleaner boundaries in family, friendship, love, and work.
Distinguish guilt from a genuine obligation to keep harmful access open.
Build a calmer life after removal instead of leaving an empty space.
the-power-of-deletion.seo_description: A practical guide to boundaries, attention, access, relationships, digital clutter, guilt, standards, and removing what repeatedly breaks inner peace.
the-power-of-deletion.subtitle: Removing What Breaks Your Peace from the Life You Are Still Building
the-power-of-deletion.summary: The Power of Deletion treats removal as an act of attention and access management rather than cruelty. It explores the hidden cost of keeping people, habits, digital noise, guilt, status games, and internal loops that repeatedly disturb the life a person is trying to build. Family, friendship, love, work, social media, body signals, standards, gradual deletion, returning people, and clean boundary language are examined alongside a seven-day practice for creating space after removal.
the-power-of-deletion.target_audience: For readers who want clearer boundaries and less repeated disruption without turning self-protection into hostility.
the-power-of-deletion.title: The Power of Deletion

learning: Understand the scope and verification method used to assemble the authorship portfolio.
Read reconstructed English synopses as editorial descriptions rather than verbatim publisher abstracts.
Use ISBN and National Library record identifiers to distinguish and verify archival entries.
See how duplicate records and author order are handled in the portfolio.
Navigate a publishing history spanning technology, business, education, psychology, relationships, and literature.
the-published-works-of-faramarz-kowsari.seo_description: Verified bibliography and authorship portfolio of Faramarz Kowsari, consolidating Iranian ISBN and National Library records with verification methodology and archival context.
the-published-works-of-faramarz-kowsari.subtitle: Verified Bibliography & Authorship Portfolio
the-published-works-of-faramarz-kowsari.summary: The Published Works of Faramarz Kowsari is an authorship portfolio designed to make a Persian-language publishing record accessible to international professional readers. It consolidates ISBN-registered publications and records associated with the National Library and Archives of Iran, explains an editorial transparency method for reconstructed English titles and synopses, documents de-duplication by ISBN and record identifiers, preserves author order, and provides verification links where available. The selected edition organizes archival works across technology and AI, business, education, psychology and mindfulness, personal development, relationships, and creative literature.
the-published-works-of-faramarz-kowsari.target_audience: For employers, academic partners, media organizations, professional reviewers, and readers who need an English-accessible overview of Faramarz Kowsari's documented publishing record.
the-published-works-of-faramarz-kowsari.title: The Published Works of Faramarz Kowsari

learning: Read ranges and transitions using evidence instead of idealized diagrams.
Apply the three Wyckoff laws to price, volume, spread, and result.
Distinguish accumulation, distribution, reaccumulation, and redistribution.
Plan entries, invalidation, stops, sizing, management, and exits.
Use multi-timeframe context, case studies, and checklists to reduce hindsight bias.
the-wyckoff-method.seo_description: A practical Wyckoff guide to accumulation, distribution, springs, upthrusts, price-volume analysis, market structure, entries, risk, and decision rules.
the-wyckoff-method.subtitle: A Practical Guide to Accumulation, Distribution, Springs, Upthrusts, and Market Structure
the-wyckoff-method.summary: The Wyckoff Method is a practical manual for reading market ranges, transitions, and trend health through observable evidence rather than memorized ideal diagrams. It develops the three Wyckoff laws, price-volume relationships, accumulation and distribution phases, springs, upthrusts, reaccumulation, redistribution, structural failure, entries, stops, position sizing, trade management, and multi-timeframe context. Case studies, checklists, and the C-R-E-S-T decision protocol turn the framework into a repeatable process while explicitly addressing ambiguous charts and the hindsight trap.
the-wyckoff-method.target_audience: For serious beginner and intermediate discretionary traders in stocks, futures, forex, crypto, price action, or SMC who want a structured Wyckoff process.
the-wyckoff-method.title: The Wyckoff Method

learning: Define self-worth through behavior and standards rather than superiority.
Find where time, health, attention, and relationships are being sold too cheaply.
Raise standards without confusing them with perfectionism or needless pain.
Practice selectivity in love, desire, habits, and mental diet.
Use AI as leverage for clearer work and less waste while keeping human judgment in charge.
you-are-too-valuable-for-less.seo_description: A practical book on self-worth, standards, health, attention, love, selectivity, intelligent leverage, and using AI without outsourcing judgment.
you-are-too-valuable-for-less.subtitle: How to Protect Your Worth, Raise Your Standards, and Use Intelligent Leverage to Build a Higher Life
you-are-too-valuable-for-less.summary: You Are Too Valuable for Less defines self-worth through standards and choices rather than superiority. It asks where a person privately discounts time, health, attention, relationships, beliefs, appetite, and energy, then develops a framework for raising standards without turning life into perfectionism. Love and desire are examined alongside selectivity, unnecessary suffering, and intelligent leverage; AI is framed as a tool for reducing waste and accelerating thought, not as an authority over human judgment.
you-are-too-valuable-for-less.target_audience: For readers who want to translate self-respect into concrete standards and a less wasteful, higher-quality life.
you-are-too-valuable-for-less.title: You Are Too Valuable for Less

learning: Separate uncontrollable events from trainable responses.
Read emotions as information without treating them as automatic instructions.
Use pause, delayed response, attention, and body awareness to slow reaction.
Apply flexible plans and boundaries in work, money, relationships, and loss.
Create a personal response protocol for difficult and unpredictable days.
you-can-t-control-life-but-you-can-train.seo_description: A practical guide to emotional discipline, pause, attention, body awareness, boundaries, uncertainty, flexible planning, and training responses instead of controlling life.
you-can-t-control-life-but-you-can-train.subtitle: Emotional Discipline, Inner Stability, and Wise Action in an Unpredictable World
you-can-t-control-life-but-you-can-train.summary: You Can’t Control Life, But You Can Train Your Response focuses on the agency that remains when events refuse to obey plans. It treats emotions as weather rather than commands and develops pause, attention, body awareness, language, boundaries, delayed response, flexible planning, and wise action across failure, delay, loss, work, money, relationships, and digital overstimulation. The closing framework helps the reader build a personal response protocol for difficult days and unpredictable situations.
you-can-t-control-life-but-you-can-train.target_audience: For readers who want greater stability and wiser action without pretending that life itself can be fully controlled.
you-can-t-control-life-but-you-can-train.title: You Can’t Control Life, But You Can Train Your Response

Yüksek bilişsel hızın yalnızlık, aşırı düşünme ve yetersiz uyarılmayla nasıl birleşebildiğini görmek.
Duygusal ve duyusal yoğunluk ile sosyal maskelemenin maliyetlerini anlamak.
Mükemmeliyetçilik, iş, otorite ve ilişkilerde daha işlevsel stratejiler geliştirmek.
Yüksek yetenek araştırmalarını örneklem ve genelleme sınırlarıyla birlikte okumak.
yuksek-cozunurluklu-zihin.seo_description: Çok yüksek IQ'lu zihinlerin bilişsel, duygusal ve sosyal psikolojisini; yalnızlık, aşırı düşünme, hassasiyet, maskeleme, iş ve ilişkiler bağlamında inceleyen kitap.
yuksek-cozunurluklu-zihin.subtitle: Son Derece Yüksek IQ’ya Sahip Zihinlerin Gizli Psikolojisi
yuksek-cozunurluklu-zihin.summary: Yüksek Çözünürlüklü Zihin, çok yüksek bilişsel kapasiteyi ne yüceltir ne de tek başına bir üstünlük ölçüsü sayar. Kitap IQ'nun sınırları, bilişsel hız ve derinlik, asenkron gelişim, yalnızlık, aşırı düşünme, duygusal yoğunluk, duyusal hassasiyet, sosyal maskeleme, yetersiz uyarılma, mükemmeliyetçilik, entelektüel tevazu, hafıza, aşk, iş, otorite, iki kez farklılık ve etik sorumluluk gibi alanları inceler. Bilimsel bulgular aktarılırken örneklem ve genelleme sınırlarına dikkat edilir.
yuksek-cozunurluklu-zihin.target_audience: Üstün yetenek, yüksek bilişsel kapasite ve bunun psikolojik-sosyal sonuçlarıyla ilgilenen okurlar için.
yuksek-cozunurluklu-zihin.title: Yüksek Çözünürlüklü Zihin

learning: Olan şey ile zihin tarafından eklenen yorumları birbirinden ayırmak.
Beden sinyallerini otomatik hikâyeden önce fark etmek.
Kaygı, öfke, utanç ve yasla sakinliği zorlamadan çalışmak.
Bildirimler, mesajlar ve dikkat dağınıklığı karşısında farkındalık geliştirmek.
Kısa geri dönüş protokolleriyle olay ve tepki arasındaki alanı büyütmek.
zihnin-ona-ad-vermeden-once.seo_description: Olay ile zihnin hikâyesi arasındaki aralığı görmek; kaygı, öfke, beden, belirsizlik, dikkat ve dijital gürültüyle çalışmak için mindfulness rehberi.
zihnin-ona-ad-vermeden-once.subtitle: Sakinliğin Gelmediği Anlar İçin Mindfulness
zihnin-ona-ad-vermeden-once.summary: Zihnin Ona Ad Vermeden Önce, mindfulness'ı zorla sakinleşmek olarak değil, olay ile zihnin o olaya verdiği isim ve hikâye arasındaki küçük aralığı görebilmek olarak ele alır. Kitap veri ile hikâyeyi, beden sinyallerini, kaygı, öfke, utanç, yas, belirsizlik, bildirimler, dikkat dağınıklığı ve sessizliği inceler. Güvenlik sınırlarını koruyarak okuyucuyu 'isimsiz alan'a, yani tepkinin otomatikleşmeden önce gözlemlenebildiği yere geri çağırır.
zihnin-ona-ad-vermeden-once.target_audience: Sakinleşmeye çalıştıkça daha çok zorlanan ve mindfulness'ı günlük hayatın gerçek anlarında kullanmak isteyen okurlar için.
zihnin-ona-ad-vermeden-once.title: Zihnin Ona Ad Vermeden Önce
